objective: Improve genuine forward 24h/7d BUY/SELL/WAIT precision, after-cost expectancy, robustness and reliability without weakening canonical validation or increasing recurring cost.
hourly_self_improvement_question: What should be added, removed, simplified, combined, deprioritized, or tested next to improve genuine after-cost signal accuracy, profitability and reliability while reducing overfitting, duplicated research and wasted compute?

priority_programs.title: Economic meta-label / selective WAIT
priority_programs.goal: Test whether pre-forecast conditions can identify primary BUY/SELL signals that should be abstained because expected after-cost value is weak.
priority_programs.promotion_rule: research -> validation -> untouched OOS -> robustness -> multiple-testing -> genuine forward; never direct production mutation

priority_programs.title: Regime x strategy shadow router
priority_programs.goal: Determine which immutable challenger strategy, if any, deserves trust in each defensibly timestamped regime; otherwise WAIT.

priority_programs.title: Cross-sectional and beta-neutral signal science
priority_programs.goal: Expand defensible residual momentum, breadth, dispersion, leadership rotation, correlation-breakdown and relative-strength challengers instead of multiplying generic indicator variants.

priority_programs.title: Economic rather than accuracy-only calibration
priority_programs.goal: Evaluate probability-weighted payoff after fees, spread and slippage so a directionally correct but economically poor signal can become WAIT.

priority_programs.title: Prospective microstructure execution veto
priority_programs.goal: Test whether spread, depth, imbalance, liquidity deterioration and size-aware expected slippage should suppress otherwise valid signals.

priority_programs.title: Independent-mechanism ensemble diversity
priority_programs.goal: Measure residual prediction/error correlation and penalize redundant strategies so apparent agreement from near-duplicate models is not mistaken for independent evidence.

remove_or_deprioritize: additional logical-worker expansion above 256 without measured information-value benefit
blind RSI/MACD/EMA or similar parameter permutations not motivated by a diagnosed resolved-error mechanism
repeated ACC-002 investigation while failures are purely InsufficientHistory
duplicate hypotheses already falsified without materially new independent evidence
features whose apparent edge vanishes after realistic fees/spread/slippage
ensemble members that add no incremental independent information
